environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) within vpc-0a3f8e. The subnet route table (rtb-07cc2d) contains only a local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a route to the SQS VPC endpoint (vpce-0b4a91, pl-63a5400a -> vpce-0b4a91). There is no NAT gateway, no internet gateway attachment, and no transit gateway route. Security group sg-0ef41a permits inbound from the SQS VPC endpoint only and outbound to 10.0.1.50/32 on port 25 plus the SQS endpoint prefix list. However, 10.0.1.50 is an internal SMTP relay that exists in subnet 10.0.2.0/24 — the route table for 10.0.4.0/24 has no peering or transit path to 10.0.2.0/24 (the VPC CIDR is 10.0.0.0/16 so local routing applies, but the SMTP host's security group sg-0dd8b3 only accepts inbound on port 25 from 10.0.3.0/24 CIDR, not from 10.0.4.0/24). Network ACL nacl-09f1a2 on subnet 10.0.4.0/24 has explicit deny rules for all egress except to the SQS VPC endpoint prefix list on port 443.

config.network_acl: nacl-09f1a2: egress deny all except pl-63a5400a:443
